segments.t: Fly to Stormwind

tips.text: Thor flies you to Stormwind. Humans need this flight for Lewis's note anyway.

segments.t: Turn in Continue to Stormwind to Osric Strang; Accept Dungar Longdrink from Osric Strang

tips.text: Osric Strang's shop is in Old Town.

segments.t: Turn in Dungar Longdrink to Dungar Longdrink; Accept Return to Lewis from Dungar Longdrink
Accept Humble Beginnings from Baros Alexston

tips.text: Baros Alexston in Cathedral Square wants his old compass from his Westfall farmhouse. You hand it in when you leave Westfall through Stormwind.

segments.t: Turn in Snatch and Grab to Master Mathias Shaw

tips.text: Rogues: hand Shaw the shipping schedule from Jerod's Landing.

segments.t: Turn in Explosive Consultation to Sprite Jumpsprocket; Accept Detonation at a Distance from Sprite Jumpsprocket

tips.text: Sprite Jumpsprocket is in the Dwarven District.

segments.t: Turn in Detonation at a Distance to Jasper Fel; Accept Detonation at a Distance from Jasper Fel

tips.text: Jasper Fel is in SI:7 in Old Town.

segments.t: Turn in Detonation at a Distance to Sprite Jumpsprocket

tips.text: Back to Sprite. The next step needs 10 Rough Dynamite from an engineer or the auction house; only bother if you plan to run the Deadmines.

segments.t: Accept A Dynamite Plan from Sprite Jumpsprocket

tips.text: If you plan to run the Deadmines: Sprite also wants 10 Rough Dynamite (engineers or the auction house).

segments.t: Complete A Dynamite Plan: 10 Rough Dynamite
Turn in A Dynamite Plan to Sprite Jumpsprocket
Accept Explosive Consultation from Sprite Jumpsprocket
Turn in Tome of Divinity to Duthorian Rall, then start The Tome of Divinity from the book he hands you

tips.text: Paladins: Duthorian Rall is in the Cathedral of Light. The Tome of Divinity chain ends with Redemption.

segments.t: Turn in The Tome of Divinity to Duthorian Rall; Accept The Tome of Divinity from Duthorian Rall
Turn in The Tome of Divinity to Stephanie Turner; Accept The Tome of Divinity from Stephanie Turner

tips.text: Stephanie Turner is in the Trade District.

segments.t: Complete The Tome of Divinity: 10 Linen Cloth

tips.text: Bring 10 Linen Cloth; you should have plenty from the Defias.

segments.t: Turn in The Tome of Divinity to Stephanie Turner; Accept The Tome of Divinity from Stephanie Turner
Turn in The Tome of Divinity to Duthorian Rall; Accept The Tome of Divinity from Duthorian Rall
Turn in The Tome of Divinity to Gazin Tenorm; Accept The Tome of Divinity from Gazin Tenorm
Complete The Tome of Divinity: Henze Faulk

tips.text: Henze Faulk lies by the road near Stone Cairn Lake in eastern Elwynn; use the Symbol of Life on him.

segments.t: Turn in The Tome of Divinity to Henze Faulk; Accept The Tome of Divinity from Henze Faulk
Complete The Tome of Divinity: Defias Script

tips.text: The Defias Script drops from Rogue Wizards north of Stone Cairn Lake.

segments.t: Turn in The Tome of Divinity to Gazin Tenorm; Accept The Tome of Divinity from Gazin Tenorm

tips.text: Back to Gazin Tenorm in the Cathedral.

segments.t: Turn in The Tome of Divinity to Duthorian Rall
Accept Collecting Memories from Wilder Thistlenettle

tips.text: Wilder Thistlenettle in the Dwarven District wants union cards from the Deadmines.

segments.t: Accept Oh Brother. . . from Wilder Thistlenettle
Accept Underground Assault from Shoni the Shilent

tips.text: Shoni is in the Dwarven District next to the tram.

segments.t: Accept Important Heirlooms from Thom Filch

tips.text: Take the Deeprun Tram from the Dwarven District to Ironforge. Thom Filch wants heirlooms from the new Hall of Thanes.

segments.t: Enter the Hall of Thanes from Old Ironforge, off the Throne Room

tips.text: New in Forever. A full party at 15 is comfortable. Instance entries are capped per hour, so don't reset carelessly.

segments.t: Accept An Ancient Grudge from the Ghostly Attendant inside the Hall of Thanes

tips.text: The Ghostly Attendant inside the dungeon gives this one.

segments.t: Complete Important Heirlooms: 8 Dwarven Heirloom

tips.text: Heirlooms are glowing objects along the halls; everyone in the party can loot them.

segments.t: Complete An Ancient Grudge: Faldrim Anvilmar
Loot Treaty of Understanding and accept The Treaty of Understanding

tips.text: The Treaty of Understanding is in the last vault. It cannot be shared; each player loots their own.

segments.t: Turn in An Ancient Grudge to the Ghostly Attendant
Turn in Important Heirlooms to Thom Filch
Turn in The Treaty of Understanding to King Magni Bronzebeard

tips.text: Magni is in the Throne Room. Take the tram back to Stormwind afterwards.

segments.t: Fly to Sentinel Hill

tips.text: Fly back to Westfall.

segments.t: Turn in Return to Lewis to Quartermaster Lewis

tips.text: Quartermaster Lewis is at the top of Sentinel Hill.
